battle.name: 漢匈戰爭
battle.brief: 公元前133年（漢武帝元光二年）七月，漢廷設馬邑之謀，以豪商聶壹詐降匈奴單于，誘其率十萬騎入塞；以三十餘萬車騎伏於馬邑旁谷中，與代郡方向援軍合圍。匈奴前哨望見塞上漢軍旗鼓與被驅趕的馬群，識破埋伏，即引兵北還，漢軍不追。卡面秦弩為漢軍標準配備，伏兵原以弩陣封谷口，卻未及發矢。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是西漢中央與匈奴游牧聯盟之間六十餘年和親體制的第一次公開破裂，爆發於漢武帝元光二年（公元前133年）七月。漢朝一方以中央直屬的車騎部隊與邊郡郡兵為骨架：雁門、代郡、上郡、漁陽等地的郡兵經材官、騎士之制編練，配弩、弓、戟、盾與環首刀，關市與塞垣由郡守、都尉分守，烽燧自代郡、雁門一路連到塞外，遇警舉火，郡兵據塞而守；另有自長安調出的車騎將軍所部，隨軍運糧車隊可達數千乘。中樞由張湯、桑弘羊、王恢等反覆計議，最後由天子下詔。匈奴一方是游牧部落的鬆散聯盟，單于為盟主，軍臣單于以左右兩部為骨幹，萬騎、千騎、百騎、十騎逐級編制，遇大戰可臨時集結十萬騎以上；前哨由數千騎擔任，探路、逼塞、掠奪牲畜，並沿用老上單于以來的射覆威懾與佯退驅敵之慣例。雙方的根本差別在體制：漢朝靠行政與物資的集中，匈奴靠騎兵的速度與分合之變，兩者在此役首次正面碰撞。
countriesEn: This war was the first open rupture of the peace-and-matrimony system that had held between the Western Han court and the Xiongnu nomadic confederation for more than sixty years, and it broke out in the seventh month of the second year of Yuanguang (133 BC) under Emperor Wu of Han. On the Han side the backbone was the chariot-and-cavalry troops of the central command together with the levies of the frontier commanderies: the counties of Yanmen, Dai, Shang and Yuyang trained their men through the caiguan and the cavalry system, equipping them with crossbows, bows, halberds, shields and ring-pommel sabres; the passes and the barrier markets were guarded by commandery governors and commandants, and a chain of beacon towers ran from Dai and Yanmen out to the desert, where a fire signal raised in the night called the garrison to its posts. In addition there were the departments of the chariot-and-cavalry generals drawn out from the capital, with several thousand grain wagons travelling with them. At the centre of government the plan was argued over by Zhang Tang, Sang Hongyang, Wang Hui and the rest before the Son of Heaven issued the order. The Xiongnu were a loose confederation of nomadic clans with the Chanyu as its leader: under Chanyu Junchen the left and right divisions formed the backbone, the units being graded in tens of thousands of riders, in thousands, in hundreds and in tens, and a great war could bring together more than a hundred thousand horsemen on the spot. Their vanguard was a few thousand riders, used to reconnoitre, to press against the passes and to carry off cattle, and they fought on the habits inherited from the reign of Old Shang, the shooting of decoys and the feigned retreat used to drive the enemy on. The real difference between the two sides lay in their organisation: the Han relied on the concentration of administration and supplies, the Xiongnu on the speed of cavalry and on the ease with which they could split and rejoin. Here, for the first time, the two systems collided.
people: 決定此役走向的是漢武帝劉徹。他在中樞聽取王恢、張湯、桑弘羊三人的計策，同意以商賈聶壹為餌設伏，隨即詔令雁門、代郡兩線備兵，親自過問軍馬與糧秣的籌措。聶壹是馬邑的豪商，最早提出把買馬做成陷阱的辦法：他自稱願以數百匹好馬獻給匈奴，並騙單于說縣官與關吏都會放行，匈奴只須入塞到馬邑，馬匹唾手可得，漢軍不會有備。這個誘餌之所以生效，是因為匈奴連年入邊所求正是馬匹與人口，而馬邑關市在停市和親的年代裡早已封閉。真正在關鍵時刻做出決定的是匈奴單于與其前哨：先行的數千騎望見塞上布列的漢軍旗鼓，又見馬群被人驅趕著在塞外徘徊，這正是漢廷預設的遮蔽手法，也是匈奴識破埋伏的關鍵；單于當機立斷引兵北還，沒有因為十萬騎的聲勢而貿然深入。漢朝方面的關鍵人物是王恢：他主張設伏並奉命自代郡出擊匈奴側翼，未及合圍便因子不出擊獲罪下獄，幾乎被處死；其後漢使赴匈奴，匈奴隱匿王恢而稱他為太子傅，漢廷驗明並非通敵，匈奴反過來如此看重他這一事實本身反證了他未曾洩漏機密，漢武帝遂赦免其罪、罷官了事。張湯在朝廷上追問王恢的責任，是此事變成朝議焦點的直接原因。主和的韓安國則反覆陳述和親與守塞的可行性，他的主張在此役之後重新抬頭。
peopleEn: What decided the course of the campaign was Emperor Wu of Han, Liu Che. He heard the scheme of Wang Hui, Zhang Tang and Sang Hongyang in the central court, agreed to use the merchant Nie Yi as the bait for an ambush, and thereupon ordered the Yanmen and Dai lines to prepare, taking a personal hand in the requisition of horses and grain. Nie Yi was a rich merchant of Mayi, and it was he who first proposed turning a horse purchase into a trap: he claimed that he would offer several hundred fine horses to the Xiongnu, and deceived the Chanyu into believing that the county magistrate and the officers at the pass would open the way, so that the Xiongnu need only ride inside the frontier to Mayi and the horses would fall into their hands, with no Han force on guard. The bait worked because what the Xiongnu had come for year after year was precisely horses and people, and the barrier market at Mayi had been shut throughout the years of the matrimony peace. The decision at the critical moment was taken by the Chanyu and by his outriders: the leading few thousand riders, seeing Han banners and drums deployed on the frontier and herds of horses being driven up and down outside the pass, recognised the arrangement for what it was, and the Chanyu turned north and withdrew at once rather than press on with the weight of a hundred thousand riders. On the Han side the key figure was Wang Hui: he had urged the ambush and was ordered to strike the flank of the Xiongnu from Dai, and when the junction never came he was charged with failing to attack, thrown into prison and very nearly put to death. Later, when a Han envoy reached the Xiongnu, they concealed Wang Hui and spoke of him as the tutor of the crown prince; the court verified that he had not betrayed them, and the very fact that the Xiongnu had hidden him and honoured him proved the opposite, so Emperor Wu pardoned him and dismissed him from office. Zhang Tang's pressing of Wang Hui for the responsibility in court is the direct reason the affair became the focus of a ministerial debate. Han Anguo, who argued for peace, set out again and again the case for the matrimony alliance and for holding the passes, and his position was revived after the campaign.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩是弩兵制的源頭：戰國末年成熟的一張弩機，銅製機件安在木弩臂上，拉弦以人力為主，貯力待發，瞄準時不必分神用力。漢承秦弩之制，公元前133年漢軍所用的弩機在形制上仍與秦弩幾乎相同，歷代出土的漢弩機可以互相印證，只是在銅件鍛造與機括細節上更為精整，這是本卡兵器真正在場的戰場。弩對漢匈之戰的意義極大：弩能單兵發射，射程遠過普通角弓，在山谷設伏、封鎖通道最為有效，一齊齊射足以覆蓋谷道；代價是裝填緩慢、連射率低，必須與騎兵、步卒和車陣配合。漢軍除弩外，還有大型反曲角弓、鐵矛、戟、銅或鐵刃的環首刀、小盾，以及護身的皮甲與札甲；弓弩手按材官與騎士分別編制，騎兵以刀與短矛配長槍。匈奴的裝備自成體系：反曲複合弓以木、角、筋三種材料複合，匈奴墓出土的弓體高逾一米，屬同類中少見的長弓，鳴鏑箭帶響孔，箭鏃多為骨或鐵；近身有環首刀、骨柄短刀與長矛，護具以皮革與毛皮為主，缺精鐵而重弓騎。雙方在馬匹與運輸上的差異同樣決定戰局：漢軍依賴運糧車隊與人工搬運的弩機裝備，匈奴則以馬肉乳酪自給，無固定補給線，靠馬力攜帶全部裝備，可以連續行軍多日不食不飲。
kitsEn: The item on the card, the Qin crossbow, is the origin of the crossbowman system: a lock brought to full maturity at the end of the Warring States, with a bronze trigger assembly fitted to a wooden bow-arm and drawn mainly by human muscle, storing the force and releasing it on a trigger, so that the archer need not hold the bow in tension while aiming. The Han inherited the crossbow of the Qin, and the locks carried by Han troops in 133 BC are almost identical in form to the Qin type, as excavated locks from Han sites bear out one another; only the casting of the bronze fittings and the detail of the mechanism were improved, which makes this card's weapon genuinely present on the field of this war. The crossbow mattered enormously in the war between Han and Xiongnu: it could be fired by a single man, it outranged the ordinary composite bow, and it was at its best in an ambush sealing a valley mouth, where a single massed volley could cover the whole defile; the price was a slow reload and a low rate of fire, so that it had to work with cavalry, infantry and the barricade of wagons. Beside the crossbow the Han carried large recurved horn bows, iron spears, halberds, ring-pommel sabres with bronze or iron blades, small shields, and leather and lamellar armour for protection; bowmen were mustered separately as caiguan and as cavalry, and horsemen carried sabres and short spears with a long lance. The Xiongnu kit formed its own system: the recurved composite bow built of wood, horn and sinew, with bows excavated from Xiongnu tombs standing over a metre tall, among the tallest of their kind anywhere, and whistling arrows with pierced heads, the points often of bone or iron; at close quarters they had ring-pommel sabres, short knives with bone handles and long spears, and their protection was mainly leather and fur, short of fine iron but strong in the bow. The difference in horses and in transport told the story as much as the arms: the Han depended on grain wagons and on crews to move the crossbows, while the Xiongnu lived on horse-meat and milk and carried no fixed supply line, everything travelling on horseback, which allowed them to march for days without provisions.
tactics: 漢軍的部署是三段式合圍：代郡方向由王恢督率的騎兵切斷匈奴退路，雁門方向以三十餘萬車騎埋伏於馬邑旁谷，等敵入谷即以弩陣封住谷道、兩翼車騎壓下，再由塞上步卒與旗鼓配合遮蔽耳目，最後由代郡方向發動側擊。塞外先以牛羊布列，牧人驅趕羊馬在塞上往來，看似邊地牧場的日常景象，實為掩蔽陣形、誘使匈奴騎兵貼近。通訊依靠烽燧：敵騎入塞即舉火，郡兵聞警據塞，漢軍主力循烽火導引完成集結。計畫中的關鍵射擊是谷口的弩陣齊射，漢弩一次齊射的覆蓋面正是伏兵制勝的依據；卡面的秦弩所代表的，正是這一套以機械蓄力換取精準與射程的遠程手段。但計畫在射擊之前便已失敗：匈奴前哨在塞外望見漢軍布列的旗鼓與驅趕的馬群，判定有備，十萬騎不戰而退，漢軍主力始終未曾與敵接觸。匈奴的戰術則是典型的草原打法：十萬騎不集中使用，分左右部輪番前出，數千騎擔任前哨，發現陷阱便全軍撤離，退走的是另一條通道而不是原路，撤退本身就是一次反包抄的準備；這種不戰而走、佯退驅敵、射覆立威的做法，自冒頓單于起便是匈奴的傳統，漢軍在漠北再也沒有遇到過可以硬吃的對手。
tacticsEn: The Han deployment was a three-stage pincer. From Dai, cavalry under Wang Hui was to cut the retreat of the Xiongnu; in the valley by Mayi, more than three hundred thousand chariot troops and horsemen were to lie in wait and seal the defile with a volley of crossbows, the cavalry on both flanks coming down on the enemy; and on the frontier itself infantry and banners were to screen the Han dispositions from sight. Outside the pass, cattle and sheep were posted first, and herdsmen drove their animals up and down the ground, so that the plain looked like an ordinary day on a frontier pasture, while in reality it concealed the order of battle and drew the Xiongnu riders close. Communication ran on beacon towers: as soon as horsemen crossed the frontier a fire was lit, the garrison manned the passes, and the main body of the Han army assembled along the route marked out by the signal. The shot on which the whole plan was built was the massed volley of crossbows at the mouth of the valley, for the ground covered by a single volley was the basis on which the ambush was to win; the Qin crossbow on the card stands for exactly this, a range weapon that buys precision and reach by storing the pull of the bow in a mechanism. But the plan failed before a single shot was fired: the Xiongnu vanguard, seeing Han banners and drums deployed on the frontier and herds being driven before them, understood that the Han were prepared, and a hundred thousand horsemen withdrew without a battle, the Han main body never once coming into contact. The Xiongnu method was the classic steppe one: a hundred thousand riders were not used in one mass, the left and right divisions came forward in turn, a few thousand served as outriders, and once a trap was detected the whole host withdrew, leaving by a road other than the one it had come in, so that the retreat itself was preparation for a counter-encirclement. This habit of withdrawing without fighting, of feigning defeat to drive the enemy on, and of establishing awe by shooting at decoys had been Xiongnu practice since the days of Modu Chanyu, and the Han were never again given an opponent in the northern desert whom they could swallow whole.
data: 可依據的數字大致如下。伏兵總數《史記·匈奴列傳》作車騎三十餘萬，集中於馬邑旁谷的谷地之中；自代郡出擊匈奴側翼的另一支軍隊由王恢督率，兵力亦以數十萬計。匈奴方面，單于以十萬騎入塞，最前出的前哨為數千騎，進至馬邑城北一帶即窺見塞上布列的漢軍。距離上，馬邑（今山西朔州）距武州塞、雁門關一線約數十里至百里，匈奴自入塞到發現埋伏不過一日行程，漢軍若能完成合圍，本可當日截住退路。時間上，此役在元光二年（公元前133年）七月。戰果方面，雙方主力未接戰，漢軍斬獲極微，故史籍對此役只記漢軍不追而無斬獲數字。兵器方面，漢弩的有效射程一般以二百步計，一弩一矢，裝填需十數步之息，故必須以陣地掩體配合連續齊射；匈奴的反曲複合弓射程與之相當，在野外機動中甚至佔優，漢弩的優勢只在固定陣地與瞄準精度。整場漢匈戰爭自公元前133年馬邑之謀起，至前89年海頭之戰後匈奴遠遁止，前後約四十四年，其間主要會戰包括前127年河南地之戰、前121年河西之戰、前119年漠南陰山之戰、前91年狼居胥山之戰與前71年漠北之戰。漢朝在此期間前後投入的兵馬以百萬計，財政開支與民力消耗至今仍是史家論武帝朝得失時的核心議題。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The size of the ambush, in the Shiji liezhuan of the Xiongnu, is given as more than three hundred thousand chariot troops and horsemen, concentrated in the ground of the valley beside Mayi; a second force under Wang Hui marched from Dai to strike the flank, likewise numbered at several tens of thousands. On the Xiongnu side the Chanyu entered the frontier with a hundred thousand riders, the leading few thousand forming the vanguard and reaching the area north of the city of Mayi, where they sighted Han troops deployed outside the pass. As for distance, Mayi, present-day Shuozhou in Shanxi, lies about several tens of li to a hundred li from the Wuzhou pass and the line of Yanmen, so the Xiongnu went no more than a day's ride from crossing the frontier to discovering the ambush, and had the Han junction been completed they could have cut the retreat the same day. In time, the campaign belongs to the seventh month of the second year of Yuanguang (133 BC). As for results, the main bodies of the two armies never engaged and the Han gains were minute, so that the histories record only that the Han army did not pursue and give no figure for prisoners or kills. In weapons, the effective range of the Han crossbow is usually reckoned at about two hundred paces, one bolt to a lock, and reloading takes a dozen breaths or so, which is why it had to be used in covered positions and in massed volleys; the range of the Xiongnu recurved composite bow is comparable and in fact better in open manoeuvring, the crossbow's advantage lying only in fixed positions and in accuracy of aim. The war between Han and Xiongnu as a whole runs from the Mayi plot of 133 BC to the retreat of the Xiongnu after the battle at Haitou in 89 BC, roughly forty-four years, its main engagements including the campaign for the land south of the Yellow River in 127 BC, the campaigns in the Hexi corridor in 121 BC, the battle of Yinshan in the southern desert in 119 BC, the fight at Langjuxu in 91 BC and the battle in the northern desert in 71 BC. The Han committed forces in the hundreds of thousands on each of these occasions, and the cost in finance and in the strength of the people remains today a central question in any reckoning of Emperor Wu's reign.
cause: 起因可分三層。第一層是邊患的實際壓力：匈奴統一草原後控弦之民強盛，連年入塞，殺略吏民、驅擄牲畜，雁門、代郡、上郡、漁陽一線的邊軍常年戒備，和親的約束力隨著每次寇邊而損耗；漢朝方面自元光元年（公元前134年）遣使責問匈奴背約，匈奴隨即斷絕和親，南下之意已明。第二層是體制與資源的對比：漢朝在兵員、糧秣與器械上佔優，卻難以在草原上追擊一支分散的騎兵；匈奴的騎兵可以在缺水缺草的漠北以數日為單位轉移，漢軍一離開邊塞就失去補給優勢，和親買來的安邊，實際上是用歲幣換取對方的節制。第三層才是馬邑之謀的直接契機：馬邑豪商聶壹見兩軍僵持之弊，心生一計，願以自己的產業作擔保，騙匈奴單于說縣官將開關賣馬，並請漢廷配合演出；漢武帝衡量之後，認為既有三十餘萬大軍與邊塞之險可恃，值得以一次大規模設伏換取邊局的徹底轉折，於是元光二年七月批准計畫並下詔備兵。漢匈之間維持了六十餘年的和親就此破裂，前後四十四年的漢匈戰爭自此展開。
causeEn: The causes run in three layers. The first is the practical pressure of the frontier raids: after uniting the steppe the Xiongnu had a strong body of men under bow-strings, and they rode in year after year, killing officials and people and carrying off cattle, so that the frontier troops of Yanmen, Dai, Shang and Yuyang were permanently on alert and the binding force of the matrimony alliance was eroded by every incursion. The Han had sent an envoy to reproach the Xiongnu for breaking faith in the first year of Yuanguang (134 BC), and the Xiongnu thereupon broke off the alliance, so the intention to ride south was already plain. The second layer is the contrast between the two systems and their resources: the Han were superior in numbers, in supplies and in siege equipment, yet found it hard to pursue a dispersed mounted force across the steppe, while the Xiongnu horse could shift across the waterless and forage-less desert of the north over a period of days, and once the Han left the frontier they lost the advantage of supply; the peace bought at the cost of annual gifts was in truth a payment for the enemy's restraint. The third layer is the immediate opening for the Mayi plot. Nie Yi, the merchant of Mayi, saw the deadlock between the two sides and conceived a plan: he offered his own property as surety, deceived the Chanyu into believing that the county magistrate would open the pass and sell horses, and asked the court to play its part in the deception. Emperor Wu weighed the matter and concluded that with more than three hundred thousand men in hand and the natural defences of the frontier on his side, it was worth risking one great ambush in the hope of turning the whole position of the frontier. The order went out in the seventh month of the second year of Yuanguang, the matrimony peace of more than sixty years was broken, and the war of forty-four years between Han and Xiongnu began.
impact: 馬邑之謀的落空改變了漢匈戰爭的打法，也改變了兩國的長期戰略。第一，漢廷第一次認定誘敵設伏不足恃：設伏未成、被敵前哨一眼看穿的教訓，使漢朝放棄了等敵入彀的思路，轉而採取主動出擊，前127年衛青出雲中、直取河南地，築朔方城；前121年霍去病兩度出河西走廊，取祁連山、焉支山，渾邪王率眾降；前119年漠南陰山之戰，漢軍大破單于主力，單于遁走；前91年狼居胥山，漢軍封狼居胥、禪于姑衍；前89年海頭之戰後，匈奴遠遁，漠南無王庭。第二，漢朝付出慘重代價才能換來這些戰果：每次出塞都在數百里內的漠北拉開數十日的戰線，糧秣、車馬、隨軍民夫與傷患的消耗，讓漢廷在武帝後期財政吃緊，巫蠱之禍與鹽鐵會議上的爭議，很大一部分正是這場戰爭的帳單。第三，戰爭的結果改寫了歐亞大陸的格局：匈奴在漠北無法立足，勢力西遷，一部分西向中亞、一部分南向河西，其結果是絲路沿線的商旅與文化交流被拉進內陸，中原邊疆的屯田、烽燧與馬政制度也藉此定型。第四，戰爭把和平的另一種樣式推上歷史：數十年血戰之後，昭君出塞，元帝宮中的和親重新成為漢匈關係的主軸，直到漢朝滅亡為止。整場漢匈戰爭因之成為中國歷史上一場漫長而徹底的邊疆戰爭，它既結束了匈奴在漠北的霸權，也把中原的軍力與財政推到極限。
impactEn: The failure of the Mayi plot changed the way the Han-Xiongnu war was fought and the long-term strategy of both sides. First, the court concluded at once that luring the enemy into an ambush was not to be relied upon; the lesson of an ambush undone and seen through at a glance by an enemy scout turned the Han away from waiting for the enemy to walk into a trap and towards active operations: in 127 BC Wei Qing marched out of Yunchun and took the land south of the Yellow River, building the city of Shuofang; in 121 BC Huo Qubing rode twice into the Hexi corridor, taking Qilian and Yanzhi, and the Hunye king came over with his people; in 119 BC the Han routed the main body of the Chanyu at Yinshan in the southern desert and the Chanyu fled; in 91 BC the Han raised the altars at Langjuxu and the Jufan at Guyan; and after the battle at Haitou in 89 BC the Xiongnu withdrew far away and there was no longer a royal court in the southern desert. Second, these results were bought at a heavy price: every campaign carried a front of hundreds of li across the northern desert for tens of days, and the drain on grain, on draught animals, on the civilians who marched with the army and on the wounded so exhausted the finances of the court in the later years of the reign that the witchcraft disaster and the debates of the Salt and Iron Discourses were in large part the bill for this war. Third, the outcome reshaped the politics of Eurasia: the Xiongnu could no longer hold the northern desert and moved west, in part towards Central Asia and in part south into the Hexi corridor, with the result that the merchants and the exchange of cultures along the Silk Road were drawn inland, while the frontier institutions of the Han, the garrison farms, the beacon towers and the horse administration, took their fixed shape as well. Fourth, the war also drove the other form of peace into history: after decades of blood, Zhaojun went out to the Xiongnu, and the matrimony alliance of the court of Emperor Yuan became the main line of Han-Xiongnu relations once more, remaining so until the fall of the Han. The Han-Xiongnu war thus became in Chinese history a long and complete frontier war, ending the Xiongnu hegemony in the northern desert while pushing the military strength and the finances of the central plains to their limit.
result: 就公元前133年七月這一場而言，結果是徹底的落空。計畫中的三段合圍一次都沒有形成：匈奴前哨在塞外望見漢軍布列的旗鼓與被人驅趕的馬群，判定馬邑谷中設有伏兵，單于當即引兵北還，十萬騎不戰而走；漢軍三十餘萬車騎自谷中待至敵退，弩陣的齊射一次也未及施放，追擊亦未實施，斬獲微乎其微。善後的代價落在王恢身上：他因子不出擊獲罪下獄，幾乎被處死；因漢使赴匈奴，匈奴匿王恢而稱其為太子傅，漢廷驗明並非通敵，遂赦免罷官。漢廷內部自此再起和親與出擊之爭，韓安國等主和派的主張重新被提出，張湯則因追責王恢而在朝中頗受非議。此役雖然沒有帶來任何戰術或疆土上的收穫，卻是漢匈戰爭本身的起點：它證明了以市易為餌的欺騙戰術在面對草原騎兵的情報能力時並不可靠，也促使漢軍把打法的重心由伏擊轉向長驅迂迴，此後衛青、霍去病在漠北與河西所行的正是這種打法。從長時段看，這場戰爭最終以公元前89年之後匈奴遠遁、漠南無王庭收場，漢朝取得河套與河西，匈奴退向漠北與西域；而馬邑之謀作為其中第一策、第一敗，也就被後世史家列為漢匈大戰的起點與漢武帝北伐的序曲。
resultEn: For July 133 BC itself the outcome is a complete failure. Not one of the three stages of the pincer came into being: the Xiongnu vanguard, seeing Han banners and drums deployed outside the pass and herds of horses being driven before them, understood that an ambush lay in the valley by Mayi, and the Chanyu turned north and withdrew at once, a hundred thousand horsemen leaving without a battle; the more than three hundred thousand Han chariot troops and horsemen waited in the valley until the enemy was gone, the volley of crossbows was not fired a single time, no pursuit was made, and the gains were minute. The bill for the failure fell on Wang Hui: charged with failing to attack he was thrown into prison and very nearly put to death, and only when a Han envoy reached the Xiongnu, and they hid him and called him the tutor of the crown prince, was it verified that he had not betrayed the court, whereupon he was pardoned and dismissed. Within the court the dispute between the matrimony alliance and the policy of attack was reopened, the arguments of the peace party under Han Anguo were revived, and Zhang Tang drew criticism in court for the way he had pressed Wang Hui. The campaign won no tactical or territorial prize, yet it is the beginning of the Han-Xiongnu war itself: it showed that a deception built on a market transaction could not be trusted against the intelligence of steppe cavalry, and it pushed the Han emphasis in tactics away from the ambush and towards the long thrust and the turning movement, which is exactly the method Wei Qing and Huo Qubing afterwards used in the northern desert and in the Hexi corridor. In the long run the war closed with the withdrawal of the Xiongnu after 89 BC and the end of the royal court in the southern desert, the Han holding the Hetao and the Hexi corridor and the Xiongnu falling back into the northern desert and towards the western regions; and the Mayi plot, the first scheme and the first defeat of that war, is listed by later historians as the opening of the Han-Xiongnu contest and the prelude to the northern campaigns of Emperor Wu.
